description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Permitted to borrow from outside Sri Lanka in Designated Foreign Currency
reasoning: This gazette content consists of a regulation made under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, which establishes a legal/regulatory framework for government borrowing in foreign currency. It falls under Legal/Regulatory (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
